source: GraphQLMatcher.operationNameMatches runs a regex operationName through MatchingTimeoutExecutor.matchesWithRegexTimeout; a catastrophic `(.*a){25}` against a 40-character operationName passes regexMatchingTimeoutMillis (here 300), logs the WARN `graphql operationName regex evaluation timed out after {}ms for pattern:{}— treating as non-match`, and the request does not match. A short operationName fails within the budget; a normal regex still matches.

steps.note: Java backtracking passes the 300 ms budget: no match
a short operationName fails within the budget: no timeout entry
